name: Two names: one plate, two hooks
when: Two characters are named one after the other (about 1 to 2 s apart) while both are on screen, with free ground in the lower-left (or lower-right) corner. One name plate in that corner holds both names; a hooked arrow (nametag-A4's) runs from each row to its person's chin.
anchor: The scene starts on the first name (at1 = 0): the plate ticks on frame 3 and types name 1 by frame 11, its hook draws from frame 9. On at2 the plate drops one row, name 2 types out and its hook draws.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.name1: the first name as the voice says it (top row, shown in capitals), 22 characters at most
vars.name2: the second name as the voice says it (bottom row, shown in capitals), 22 characters at most
vars.at1: seconds after the start: when the first name is said (normally 0, the scene starts on it)
vars.at2: seconds after the start: when the second name is said
vars.head1X: person 1: x in px of the bottom of the chin on the 1920x1080 frame. Read it off a snapshot; 60 px off still reads right
vars.head1Y: person 1: y of the bottom of the chin (the hook stops 20 px under it)
vars.head2X: person 2: x of the bottom of the chin
vars.head2Y: person 2: y of the bottom of the chin
vars.plateSide: left (plate lower-left, people to its right) or right (plate lower-right, people to its left)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later); at least 1.4 s after at2

changed: nametag-A's plate holds both names: the second arrives with the role line's one-row drop and types out. Each row sends nametag-A4's hooked arrow to its person. The person nearer the plate should be the first name (top row) so the hooks don't cross. No face box.
